findings.subject: ACCEPTED mint uniqueness
findings.description: acceptReviewJob has exactly one call site (scripts/gov-controller-ingest-result.mjs); ensureCurrentReviewJob never advances a job past REQUIRED.

findings.subject: B2-2 authority-bound job root
findings.description: review-job root is dirname(resolve(gitTopLevel(binding.worktree), binding.out_dir)); process.cwd() plays no role; N3 proves a foreign cwd cannot relocate the job; every ensure re-verifies against persisted state.outDir (REVIEW_JOB_ROOT_BINDING_DRIFT).

findings.subject: B2-3 lifecycle identity chain
findings.description: admissionId, bindingDigest, sourceAuthorityDigest, outDir, baselineContentDigest persisted on the job with seven drift guards (N2, N4-N9); lineage/jobId/spec/live-candidate also verified on every resume.

findings.subject: B2-5 Controller ingest independence
findings.description: ingest derives the governed root from v3 closeout_metadata and validates the job chain vs authorityDigest(record) + persisted state before acceptance — never trusts delivery.json claims, caller metadata, filenames, or cwd.

findings.subject: B2-6 terminal semantics
findings.description: state-driven terminal after completion: APPLIED+PASS + review outstanding is REVIEW_PENDING (never PASS); governance-domain re-entry resumes and reuses the job; implementation-domain mutation HOLDs via REVIEW_JOB_CANDIDATE_DRIFT.

findings.subject: Resume matrix + acceptance tests
findings.description: B2-7 matrix A-E and T1-T4 + N1-N12 all green; durable checkpoint resume keeps exactly one job and the frozen admission identity.

findings.subject: Coordinator candidate compare is plan-time
findings.description: the consumer gate feeds the plan-time liveReviewBinding; for post-acceptance verdict consumption the candidate compare should be re-derived at consumption time (ingest already recomputes independently at acceptance).

findings.subject: Zero-digest authority_record_digest
findings.description: default remains unguarded for lifecycle-inactive admissions (guarded by ZERO64 in resolveReviewCloseout when a binding is present).

findings.subject: Legacy external-review-result.json readers
findings.description: still read by integration-commit/draft-pr/push gates (CLI-only flows, not wired into runAdmittedGraph/coordinator).

summary: Independent review of the REVART-LC1-B2 changeset (review-job materialization + controller ingest convergence).
